meta.title: Chot kien truc, schema va cong nghe

prompt.goal: Chot frontend, API, database, auth flow, data model va ranh gioi he thong truoc khi code.
prompt.context: Read the requirements and task breakdown before making any suggestion. This task only needs design decisions and a concise implementation boundary.

scope.allowed: - Chot React + Vite + TypeScript cho frontend - Chot Node.js + Express + TypeScript cho API - Chot Supabase Free (PostgreSQL) cho database - Chot email/password, signup by email, forgot password by OTP/email - Chot data model high level cho user, acc, membership, invitation, status_history, session - Chot rule 7 ngay session, 3 tab danh sach, 24h invitation, toi da 5 member, chu phong co quyen rieng
scope.notAllowed: - Khong code feature thuc te - Khong build UI chi tiet - Khong toi uu performance sau

hardRules.rule: Stay within the chosen stack and MVP constraints.
Do not introduce admin role unless explicitly required.
Keep the output concise enough to become a handoff doc for the next task.

tasks.task: Summarize the architecture in 1 short section.
List the core entities and their relationships.
List the technical decisions that are already locked.
List the business rules that later tasks must follow.

constraints.constraint: Keep the design portable to Vercel + Supabase.

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Team can use the output directly to start implementation tasks.
No later task has to guess the stack, auth, DB, or core rules.
The output contains a clear frontend/API/database boundary.

testPlan.item: Cross-check the proposed rules against the FRS.
Check that the output is sufficient to write the next prompt without ambiguity.
